attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry names all three of its members and gives each his own couplet, so it is one folder per named member and each relates the others. The corpus keeps several men called Martin on other days — 10 November, 12 November, 22 September among them; those are other entries on the same calendar and therefore other commemorations. No year, so no `dates` object. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
